text:
Ava: FYI customer (Acme-Analytics) reports AWS marketplace accelerator credits showing in AWS console but not reflected in Redwood balance for their subaccount. Says marketplace shows 'Pending' and the grant appears attached to a different (old) master account. Can someone take a look?

Jamal: Can you paste Redwood account id + marketplace order/entitlement id?

Ava: Sure — Redwood acct: `acct-ACME-12345`
Order id: `mkt-aws-2025-7788`
Entitlement id: `ent-0a1b2c`
Customer also provided AWS payer account: `111122223333`

Support-Bot: Ticket created: #SUP-2026-1442 — https://redwood.support/ticket/1442

Billing: Pulled logs — looks like our marketplace webhook returned 500 for that entitlement on `2025-11-02T18:12:47Z`. Log excerpt: ```error: Missing mapping for marketplace_customer_id 'amzn:pr-987654321098' at /integrations/marketplace/handler -> 500```

Michael: This often happens when the marketplace grant is applied to a different AWS payer than the one the customer used to create the Redwood subaccount. Does the marketplace payer match the `111122223333` they shared?

Ava: The AWS console screenshots customer sent show the grant tied to `987654321098` (old master/payer). So yes — entitlement is on the wrong marketplace account and our reconcile mapping doesn't point it at `acct-ACME-12345`.

Lina: Plan: patch mapping then reprocess the webhook. Steps I will follow: 
1) Add mapping `marketplace_account_mapping["987654321098"] -> acct-ACME-12345` (and verify `111122223333` payer alias)
2) Re-run the webhook processor endpoint: `POST /internal/marketplace/reprocess` payload `{"entitlement_id":"ent-0a1b2c"}`
3) Confirm credits posted + audit entry.
I will run in staging first, then prod.

OpsOnCall: @Lina please run staging, include a clear audit trail (who/when/why). Approve manual promo while we reconcile? Customer needs access ASAP.

Ava: Customer asked if we can add a temporary credit while this is resolved. Can billing apply a temporary promo?

Billing: We can apply manual promo of `$5,000` to `acct-ACME-12345` once Ops signs off — will need ticket note and reason.

OpsOnCall: Verbal OK for $5k temporary credit. Lina — add annotation `manual_promo_applied:true` in audit.

Lina: Reprocessed in prod at `2025-11-03T02:35:10Z`. Webhook reprocess returned 200 and processor applied the entitlement. System logs: ```INFO reprocess: entitlement ent-0a1b2c processed -> credited 5000 to acct-ACME-12345; audit_id a4f7e2```
I also pushed mapping change to `marketplace_account_mapping` and verified reconciliation run.

Ava: Customer confirms balance now shows $5,000 credits and they can proceed :tada:

Michael: I'll open contact with AWS Partner Support to re-associate the entitlement to the customer's current payer account to prevent recurrence.

Support-Bot: Ticket #SUP-2026-1442 updated: resolved by manual credit + webhook reprocess. Marking ready for closure pending customer confirmation.

Ava: Customer satisfied, closing thread :white_check_mark:
